connector.name: IBM Code Engine MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Deploy to IBM Code Engine from Cursor, Copilot, Claude & Cline. Build, push, deploy via MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package code-engine-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the markusvankempen account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IBMCLOUD_API_KEY

env.name: IBMCLOUD_REGION
env.description: Default IBM Cloud region (for example: us-south)

env.name: CONTAINER_RUNTIME
env.description: Optional container runtime override: docker or podman
